formula: cbind(ballots_cast, active - ballots_cast) ~ 0 + ep + z_share_ba_plus + z_median_age + z_share_moved_past_year + z_share_owner_occupied + (1 | county:party_group) + (1 | county:election_type) + (1 | obs)
formula_notes: ep = interaction(election, party_group, drop = TRUE): a free statewide level for each of the 15 election x party cells present (OTH is absent from the closed primaries).
simplification: The briefed formula and both prescribed simplifications are singular: (1 | county:party_group:election_type) is estimated at 0 (it is nearly the same as (1 | obs), with at most three rows per cell and election type), and (1 | county) is estimated at exactly 0 once the covariates are in (sd 0.195 without them): the covariates and (1 | county:party_group) take up all county-level variation. The final fit is simplification 1 without (1 | county); since that variance was 0 the estimates are unchanged.
